name: Statius
credit: No portrait known · text from theoi.com (J. H. Mozley, Loeb Classical Library, 1928)
bio: Publius Papinius Statius was a Roman poet who flourished in the late first century AD, under the Emperor Domitian.

He wrote a collection of occasional poems, the Silvae, the twelve-book epic Thebaid on the Seven against Thebes, and the unfinished Achilleid on the youth of Achilles; the Silvae are not included here.
